name: Create D1 Database
description: Create D1 Database Returns the created D1 database. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/d1/database
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/d1/database
Returns the created D1 database.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete D1 Database
description: Delete D1 Database Deletes the specified D1 database. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/d1/database/{database_id}

name: Export D1 Database as SQL
description: Export D1 Database as SQL Returns a URL where the SQL contents of your D1 can be downloaded. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/d1/database/{database_id}/export
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/d1/database/{database_id}/export
Returns a URL where the SQL contents of your D1 can be downloaded. Note: this process may take some time for larger DBs, during which your D1 will be unavailable to serve queries. To avoid blocking your DB unnecessarily, an in-progress export must be continually polled or will automatically cancel.
Required: account_id (path); database_id (path); body (body)

name: Get D1 Database
description: Get D1 Database Returns the specified D1 database. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/d1/database/{database_id}
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/d1/database/{database_id}
Returns the specified D1 database.
Required: account_id (path); database_id (path)
Optional: fields (query) — Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. When omitted, all fields are returned.

name: Import SQL into your D1 Database
description: Import SQL into your D1 Database Generates a temporary URL for uploading an SQL file to, then instructing the D1 to import it and polling it for status updates. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/d1/database/{database_id}/import
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/d1/database/{database_id}/import
Generates a temporary URL for uploading an SQL file to, then instructing the D1 to import it and polling it for status updates. Imports block the D1 for their duration.
Required: account_id (path); database_id (path); body (body)

name: List D1 Databases
description: List D1 Databases Returns a list of D1 databases. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/d1/database
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/d1/database
Returns a list of D1 databases.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: name (query); page (query); per_page (query)

name: Query D1 Database
description: Query D1 Database Returns the query result as an object. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/d1/database/{database_id}/query
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/d1/database/{database_id}/query
Returns the query result as an object.
Required: account_id (path); database_id (path); body (body)

name: Raw D1 Database query
description: Raw D1 Database query Returns the query result rows as arrays rather than objects. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/d1/database/{database_id}/raw
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/d1/database/{database_id}/raw
Returns the query result rows as arrays rather than objects. This is a performance-optimized version of the /query endpoint.
Required: account_id (path); database_id (path); body (body)

name: Get D1 database bookmark
description: Get D1 database bookmark Retrieves the current bookmark, or the nearest bookmark at or before a provided timestamp. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/d1/database/{database_id}/time_travel/bookmark
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/d1/database/{database_id}/time_travel/bookmark
Retrieves the current bookmark, or the nearest bookmark at or before a provided timestamp. Bookmarks can be used with the restore endpoint to revert the database to a previous point in time.
Required: account_id (path); database_id (path)
Optional: timestamp (query) — An optional ISO 8601 timestamp. If provided, returns the nearest available bookmark at or before this timestamp. If omitted, returns the current bookmark.

name: Restore D1 Database to a bookmark or point in time
description: Restore D1 Database to a bookmark or point in time Restores a D1 database to a previous point in time either via a bookmark or a timestamp. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/d1/database/{database_id}/time_travel/restore
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/d1/database/{database_id}/time_travel/restore
Restores a D1 database to a previous point in time either via a bookmark or a timestamp.
Required: account_id (path); database_id (path)
Optional: bookmark (query) — A bookmark to restore the database to. Required if `timestamp` is not provided.; timestamp (query) — An ISO 8601 timestamp to restore the database to. Required if `bookmark` is not provided.

name: Update D1 Database
description: Update D1 Database Updates the specified D1 database. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/d1/database/{database_id}

name: Update D1 Database partially
description: Update D1 Database partially Updates partially the specified D1 database. PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/d1/database/{database_id}
